sloka: गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषणम् ।भर्तारमिव सम्प्राप्ता जानकी मुदिता ऽभवत् ।। ५.३६.४।।।।
transliteration: gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam ।bhartāramiva samprāptā jānakī muditā 'bhavat ।। 5.36.4।।।।

translations.english: She received the ornament that adorned her husband's hand and gazed at it and felt delighted as though her husband had arrived.
